## Load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(seminr)
library(DiagrammeRsvg)
library(rsvg)

dir.create("bruteforce_model_outputs", showWarnings = FALSE)

save_plot <- function(model_object, filename, title_text = "") {
  p <- plot(model_object, title = title_text)
  svg_text <- DiagrammeRsvg::export_svg(p)
  svg_text <- sub("(<svg[^>]*>)",
                   "\\1\n<rect width=\"100%\" height=\"100%\" fill=\"white\"/>",
                   svg_text)
  rsvg::rsvg_png(charToRaw(svg_text),
                  file.path("bruteforce_model_outputs", paste0(filename, ".png")),
                  width = 1400)
}

save_summary <- function(boot, est, filename) {
  filepath <- file.path("bruteforce_model_outputs", paste0(filename, ".txt"))
  sink(filepath)
  cat(filename, "\n")
  cat(paste(rep("=", 60), collapse = ""), "\n\n")
  print(summary(boot))
  cat("\n\nModel summary (estimate):\n")
  cat(paste(rep("-", 60), collapse = ""), "\n")
  print(summary(est))
  sink()
}
```

## Load data

```{r}
df_macro <- read.csv("sem_dataset_macro.csv")
df_micro <- read.csv("sem_dataset_micro.csv")
```

## Helper functions

```{r}
model_specs <- list()

get_vote_r2 <- function(est_summary) {
  if (!is.null(est_summary$paths)) {
    paths <- as.data.frame(est_summary$paths)
    if ("VOTE" %in% colnames(paths) && "R^2" %in% rownames(paths)) {
      return(as.numeric(paths["R^2", "VOTE"]))
    }
  }
  if (!is.null(est_summary$r_squared)) {
    r2_table <- as.data.frame(est_summary$r_squared)
    if ("VOTE" %in% rownames(r2_table)) {
      return(as.numeric(r2_table["VOTE", 1]))
    }
  }
  NA_real_
}

get_path_text <- function(est_summary) {
  paths <- as.data.frame(est_summary$paths)
  if (!"VOTE" %in% colnames(paths)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  path_rows <- setdiff(rownames(paths), c("R^2", "AdjR^2"))
  paste(path_rows, round(paths[path_rows, "VOTE"], 3), collapse = "; ")
}

make_single_item_mm <- function(indicators) {
  construct_objects <- lapply(names(indicators), function(construct_name) {
    composite(construct_name, single_item(unname(indicators[[construct_name]])))
  })
  do.call(
    constructs,
    c(construct_objects, list(composite("VOTE", single_item("republican_pct"))))
  )
}

make_grouped_mm <- function(groups) {
  construct_objects <- lapply(names(groups), function(construct_name) {
    cols <- unname(groups[[construct_name]])
    if (length(cols) == 1) {
      composite(construct_name, single_item(cols))
    } else {
      composite(construct_name, cols, weights = mode_B)
    }
  })
  do.call(
    constructs,
    c(construct_objects, list(composite("VOTE", single_item("republican_pct"))))
  )
}

screen_direct_model <- function(data, measurement_model, structural_model,
                                model_id, family, label, n_predictors) {
  tryCatch({
    est <- estimate_pls(
      data = data,
      measurement_model = measurement_model,
      structural_model = structural_model
    )
    est_summary <- summary(est)
    r2 <- get_vote_r2(est_summary)
    adj_r2 <- 1 - (1 - r2) * ((nrow(data) - 1) / (nrow(data) - n_predictors - 1))

    model_specs[[model_id]] <<- list(
      data = data,
      measurement_model = measurement_model,
      structural_model = structural_model,
      label = label
    )

    tibble(
      model_id = model_id,
      family = family,
      label = label,
      n_predictors = n_predictors,
      r2 = r2,
      adj_r2 = adj_r2,
      paths = get_path_text(est_summary),
      error = NA_character_
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    tibble(
      model_id = model_id,
      family = family,
      label = label,
      n_predictors = n_predictors,
      r2 = NA_real_,
      adj_r2 = NA_real_,
      paths = NA_character_,
      error = e$message
    )
  })
}
```

## Macro subset screen

```{r}
macro_topics <- c(
  DEMLAW = "Governance_Democracy_salience",
  DOMPOL = "Public_Health_salience",
  ECON = "Economy_salience",
  FORPOL = "Foreign_Policy_salience",
  IMMIG = "Immigration_salience",
  SOCISS = "Social_Issues_salience"
)

macro_results <- list()
counter <- 1

for (k in 2:length(macro_topics)) {
  topic_combos <- combn(names(macro_topics), k, simplify = FALSE)

  for (combo_names in topic_combos) {
    indicators <- macro_topics[combo_names]
    mm <- make_single_item_mm(indicators)
    sm <- relationships(paths(from = names(indicators), to = "VOTE"))

    model_id <- paste0("macro_subset_", counter)
    label <- paste(combo_names, collapse = " + ")

    macro_results[[counter]] <- screen_direct_model(
      data = df_macro,
      measurement_model = mm,
      structural_model = sm,
      model_id = model_id,
      family = "macro_subsets",
      label = label,
      n_predictors = length(indicators)
    )

    counter <- counter + 1
  }
}

macro_screen <- bind_rows(macro_results) %>%
  arrange(desc(adj_r2))

write.csv(macro_screen,
          file.path("bruteforce_model_outputs", "macro_subset_screen.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

macro_screen
```

## Logical construct screen

    )

  macro_material_symbolic = list(
    data = df_macro,
    groups = list(

      SYMBOLIC = c("Foreign_Policy_salience", "Governance_Democracy_salience", "Social_Issues_salience")

  micro_policy_conflict_broad = list(

    groups = list(

      CONFLICT = c("israel_palestine_salience", "felon_conviction_salience", "gender_abortion_salience")
    )
  ),
  micro_policy_conflict_refined = list(
    data = df_micro,

      POLICY = c("border_security_salience", "healthcare_medicare_salience"),
      CONFLICT = c("israel_palestine_salience", "felon_conviction_salience")
    )
  ),
  micro_democracy_conflict = list(
    data = df_micro,
    groups = list(
      DEMOCRACY = c("felon_conviction_salience", "project_2025_salience", "authoritarian_rhetoric_salience"),
      CONFLICT = c("israel_palestine_salience", "gender_abortion_salience", "race_discourse_salience")
    )
  ),
  micro_security_conflict = list(
    data = df_micro,
    groups = list(
      SECURITY = c("border_security_salience", "fentanyl_drugs_salience"),
      CONFLICT = c("israel_palestine_salience", "felon_conviction_salience", "authoritarian_rhetoric_salience")
    )
  ),
  micro_economic_security = list(
    data = df_micro,
    groups = list(
      ECONOMIC = c("inflation_economy_salience", "tax_policy_salience", "healthcare_medicare_salience"),
      SECURITY = c("border_security_salience", "fentanyl_drugs_salience", "china_geopolitics_salience")
    )
  )
)

logical_results <- list()
counter <- 1

for (set_name in names(logical_construct_sets)) {
  spec <- logical_construct_sets[[set_name]]
  mm <- make_grouped_mm(spec$groups)
  sm <- relationships(paths(from = names(spec$groups), to = "VOTE"))

  model_id <- paste0("logical_", counter)
  label <- set_name

  logical_results[[counter]] <- screen_direct_model(
    data = spec$data,
    measurement_model = mm,
    structural_model = sm,
    model_id = model_id,
    family = "logical_constructs",
    label = label,
    n_predictors = length(spec$groups)
  )

  counter <- counter + 1
}

logical_screen <- bind_rows(logical_results) %>%
  arrange(desc(adj_r2))

write.csv(logical_screen,
          file.path("bruteforce_model_outputs", "logical_construct_screen.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

logical_screen
```

write.csv(all_screen,

```

## Bootstrap strongest candidates

```{r}
top_models <- all_screen %>%
  slice_head(n = 25)

boot_results <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(top_models))) {
  model_id <- top_models$model_id[i]
  spec <- model_specs[[model_id]]

  est <- estimate_pls(
    data = spec$data,
    measurement_model = spec$measurement_model,
    structural_model = spec$structural_model
  )

  set.seed(42)
  boot <- bootstrap_model(est, nboot = 5000)

  filename <- paste0("BOOT_", sprintf("%02d", i), "_", model_id)
  save_plot(boot, filename, spec$label)
  save_summary(boot, est, filename)

  boot_paths <- as.data.frame(summary(boot)$bootstrapped_paths)
  boot_paths$model_id <- model_id
  boot_paths$label <- spec$label
  boot_paths$path <- rownames(boot_paths)
  rownames(boot_paths) <- NULL

  boot_results[[i]] <- boot_paths
}

boot_path_results <- bind_rows(boot_results)

write.csv(boot_path_results,
          file.path("bruteforce_model_outputs", "top_bootstrapped_paths.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

boot_path_results
```
